reviews.title: New update not good!
reviews.text: It appears there has been an update and I’m not liking it. When I tap on the screen to open the narration (reading). The controls take up way too much space. And when it gets to the end of the chapter it drops out before I can tap advance button to read the next chapter. In doing a through the Bible daily reading you have to read two or more chapters for each day. Before this update to read the next chapter all I had to do was tap the right arrow at the top right of the screen and the next chapter would start. Now I’m having to tap the top right button and restart the narration. It’s too cumbersome to have to do two taps when I want to read along with the next chapter. The old way was much better. I hope you can fix this issue. I will be looking at other Bible apps such as e-Sword and others. If you fix it I can give more stars on a new review.
